name: hero-cover
title: Centered Hero (Cover)

media: cover background image (optional — omit for solid-overlay hero)

locked: block nesting: cover > inner-container > group(constrained) > [heading, paragraph, buttons]
exactly one h1 (level 1) — this is the page's primary heading
parameterizationRules: dimRatio is CONDITIONAL on whether a background image is set. With an image: 50-60 (darkens the image for text legibility). With NO image (solid-color hero): 100 (full opacity so the overlay color shows solid). Confirmed via Playground 2026-05-27 — dimRatio 60 with no image renders a washed translucent gray, not a solid hero. The AI must set dimRatio based on the image slot, not freely.
notes: Distinctiveness comes from token values (overlay color, type scale) + optional background image, NOT from restructuring. The h1 here is the document's single h1; downstream patterns must use h2+. The outline button uses a block style variation (is-style-outline) that the theme.json must register or core provides.
